final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT media_type, rate, rate - avg_rate AS above_average FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE rate > avg_rate
